caption: Far-tier formations can now fight. Both regiments here are demoted to the aggregate (far) tier and stay there through contact: previously they would have marched into each other and stood locked, unable to take a casualty, lose morale, or rout until promotion handed them back to close-tier combat. Battle's tick now resolves far-tier attrition through the same UnitCombat.register_casualties / Unit._rout() path the close tier uses, so the enemy infantry thins under the spearmen, its morale runs out, and it breaks and flees.
